title: Pollbook Build Workstation Integrity Check — Polling Location 6

fields.organization: Lisle County Board of Elections — Voting Systems
fields.location: Pollbook Build Workstation LCBOE-PB01, Level 2, Election Operations Center
fields.summary: The air-gapped Pollbook build workstation LCBOE-PB01 has been physically inspected and confirmed to contain a valid, unaltered copy of the VoterTrack export from 10/28/2026. The digital signature in the chain of custody log matches the hash of the export file. The workstation is not connected to any network, including the county LAN, the internet, or internal systems. No unauthorized access or tampering has been detected. The system is now in manual mode and can be used to rebuild Polling Location 6’s pollbook using the trusted offline copy.

findings.notes: No network interface active; no Ethernet, Wi-Fi, or Bluetooth detected
Workstation locked in isolated cabinet, door secured with Seal A0048213
SHA-256 hash of VoterTrack export (10/28/2026) matches chain of custody log entry FIR-2026-1029-0945
Signature verified by LCBOE-PB01 using trusted root key
All remote access ports disabled; no active remote sessions
Last access recorded 10/28/2026 at 18:30; no logs for 10/29/2026
No evidence of unauthorized software or firmware modification
All transfer logs, seal numbers, and timestamps match in LCBOE-PB01 custody record
Workstation operating in full manual mode; no auto-sync or network polling
No user logged in; physical access log shows no entries since 10/28

actionsTaken: Confirmed air-gapped status and physical isolation of LCBOE-PB01
Verified hash and digital signature of 10/28/2026 VoterTrack export
Disabled all remote access and network ports
Initiated manual mode for pollbook rebuild
recommendations: Proceed with manual pollbook rebuild for Polling Location 6 using LCBOE-PB01
Disable all network-facing services on LCBOE-PB01 until system is cleared for production
Verify all staff have MFA and account access revoked for compromised users
fields.photosNote: 4 photos attached: IMG_1024-1015-01 (LCBOE-PB01 cabinet), IMG_1024-1015-02 (seal A0048213), IMG_1024-1015-03 (workstation console), IMG_1024-1015-04 (chain of custody log)

instructorNote: This inject confirms the air-gapped workstation is clean and usable for recovery. The VSM must now authorize the manual rebuild, and IT must verify the integrity before proceeding.
